findings.finding: The authored exponential/two-tone envelope is algebraically defined, not measured or Hilbert-extracted. Only its undamped modulation factor repeats; phase-matched samples are not automatically maxima, and a squared envelope has no automatic physical-energy interpretation.

Original-origin cropping, full target alignment and fitted gain are separate questions. The full8-frame reference target is retained; a6-frame zero prefix cannot hide the changed tail. Silent raw equality and undefined gain coexist.

Population normalization loses positive affine level/offset information; absolute correlation also loses polarity. Constant correlation is undefined. Real-arithmetic inverse metadata does not promise original float-byte reconstruction.

Actual six source/provenance/historical-result copies distinguish current76ef engine reading from the runner's olderdc2e engine. The retained0.11416614959438576dB improvement fails its1dB gate; toy calculations neither reverse that failure nor diagnose its cause.

Actual OpenStax mathematical beat text and NIST centered/sign correlation definition were read. Lesson vectors/examples are authored; no textbook images, stimuli or exercises are reproduced and no listening/statistical inference is imported. No new render,worklet/browser or learner trial occurred.

The plan follows initial reading/hand-worked examples rather than preregistering a physical experiment. Direct calculations and explicit comparison records remain simpler baselines before any unimplemented agentic/audio DSL.
